origin: User approved free-supporter-action formation approach after choosing offline-only solo group combat.
scope: design-only; no production or playtest code changes

abandonedAssumptions: old M01 3-vs-3 design must not constrain new group encounter
online/server architecture is not a requirement for this offline product

adoptedActionPolicy.whoCanInitiate: a living action-capable directly controlled unit; friendly AI also if friendly-ai-formation-enabler is equipped and AI initiation is player-enabled
adoptedActionPolicy.aiCanAutoInitiateFormation: enabled only by friendly-ai-formation-enabler with player toggle ON; uses own action and EN
adoptedActionPolicy.initiatorEnergyCost: selected technique's adopted EN cost; AI activator pays own EN if unlocked
adoptedActionPolicy.participantReuseSameRound: unlimited in different techniques while prerequisites hold; same technique only once per allied team's round
adoptedActionPolicy.formationSnapshot: evaluate all source, positions, alive, disabled, geometry, energy and target legality immediately before committing the initiator action
adoptedActionPolicy.invalidRequest: reject atomically; do not consume EN/action or alter supporter state
adoptedActionPolicy.afterResolution: the initiator ends its normal action, supporters retain independent initiative slots and normal actions regardless of whether they participated
adoptedActionPolicy.nonReversal: once a committed formation resolves, later ally movement, knockback or defeat does not retroactively undo effects
adoptedActionPolicy.sharedTechniqueCooldown: each named technique can be initiated once per round by the whole allied team; other technique may use same supporter again

pincer.geometry: enemy sandwiched from opposite orthogonal directions

energyAndBuffRules.ordinaryMoveAndKillRecovery: inherit game-wide rules; no bonus specifically for being a participant
energyAndBuffRules.nonStackingPair: same-type pair buff is not multiplied by repeatedly involving the same source; duration refresh/stacking with other defense remains future balance clarification
energyAndBuffRules.timing: damage/healing should follow the global single-atomic-action rules when defined

friendlyAIPolicy.tacticChanges: player commands, no action/EN cost, persistent until changed
highLevelPriorities: follow player's current objective and formation assistance when applicable
favor an already established useful formation unless better tactical value requires moving
maximize normal attack effectiveness without moving into avoidable trouble
friendlyAIPolicy.assistPositioning: on its own turn, an AI supporter may choose a legal destination that enables a player robot's future formation; it does not move out of turn on the player's command
friendlyAIPolicy.skillConsent: player chooses player-controlled activator/skill/target; optional friendly AI initiation must be separately enabled by equipped friendly-ai-formation-enabler and uses AI's action and own EN

examples.situation: player A acts first; friendly AI F has not acted
examples.result: A uses line for EN40/action1. F pays no cost and still takes its scheduled turn.

examples.situation: friendly AI F moved and attacked earlier this round
examples.result: A may still use F to complete pair/delta formation if F is alive and eligible.

examples.situation: player A and then player B use friendly AI F in one round
examples.result: both may commit independently; F loses neither action nor EN and has no participation cooldown.
no formation committed; all EN, turns, statuses and positions unchanged.
not counted; if required formation fails, do not consume any resources.

examples.situation: A activates pair before enemies act
examples.result: only A receives 30% damage reduction from subsequent attacks until the start of A's next turn.

examples.situation: three allied participants, mixed human and friend AI, form L-in-2x2
examples.result: A alone spends EN75/action1; up to 3 target hits resolve in one batch; supporters do not attack or spend EN.

unresolvedNotApproved: How pair damage reduction combines with shield, defend and other damage reduction sources
Whether certain stun/abnormal statuses make supporters action-disabled, once those statuses are defined
Precise step and priority scheduling for friendly AI formation positioning and risk scores
Precise combat damage/kill/EN event ordering and effect visuals for simultaneous multi-target attacks
Exact line/pair geometry beyond specified participants and cap behavior; rounding timing of effective DEF and amplifier applied after formula
Friendly-AI formation auto-initiation exact priority scoring and player toggle UX
nextDesignStage: Create a small offline combat-group scenario with 3 player robots, 2 friend AI, first lightweight squad, and verify turn order, AI positioning, and formation opportunities before implementing runtime gameplay.

sharedTechniqueCooldown.notes: same named technique only once per round across all directly-controlled and friendly AI initiators; supporter can still join other techniques

supersededMechanics: unlimited number of same named formations per allied round
